interpretation: The material status update is the regulator’s operating listing, not the mere arrival of 44 docket rows in the collector. The September table gives an August 3 operational date for Socrates South. Retain both dates: the milestone and the date of the regulator’s snapshot.

The 200 MW figure is a gas-generation capacity boundary. The regulator explains that map nameplate capacity reflects approved units and amendments. Its operating classification does not mean that all 200 MW are currently delivered to computing, and storage is excluded from the gas rating.

The October 26 filing may contain useful operating or complaint information. Its title alone cannot establish whether there were complaints, whether conditions were met or whether equipment changed. Those findings remain pending source-file review.

facts.value: 26-0169-EL-BLN; 109-acre site near Clover Valley Road and Harrison Road NW, New Albany, Licking County
Approved June 25, 2026; under construction in OPSB’s September 17, 2026 table
250 MW gas-generation capacity in the official status table and announcement
116 MW of battery energy storage; 36 construction and operating conditions. Storage duration is not stated in the reviewed announcement
Sidecat, LLC, a Meta affiliate; behind-the-meter with no physical connection to the electric power grid as described by OPSB
October 26, 2026: notice of compliance with Condition 15 (2026 Q3). Report contents remain pending

interpretation: Use June 25 as the approval date shown in the regulator’s status table. June 26 is the publication date of its announcement. Keeping these dates separate prevents a news timestamp from becoming a permit-decision date.

BTW’s older uncited event archive used 296 MW of turbines. The accessible regulator sources use 250 MW for the gas facility. This dossier uses the regulator’s stated project boundary and preserves the discrepancy for reconciliation against the underlying technical filings. The reviewed evidence does not establish a 46 MW physical reduction.
The battery’s 116 MW power rating is separate from gas generation. It is not 116 MWh, does not establish duration and should not be added to gas capacity as continuously deliverable power.
A quarterly compliance filing can precede operation. The October notice does not itself override the dated under-construction classification or prove commissioning.

faq.q: Is STY a 366 MW continuously available power plant?
faq.a: The reviewed sources do not establish that. They describe 250 MW of gas generation and separate 116 MW battery power, without a storage-duration figure.
That is not established. An older BTW event used 296 MW without a source link. The current official sources describe a 250 MW project; the technical basis for the difference remains unresolved.
